vocab.definition: a shared pair of electrons between two non-metal atoms.
two or more atoms joined by covalent bonds.
weak force between molecules (not the bond).
a small molecule like H₂O, CO₂ or Cl₂.

misconceptions.right: Covalent bonds are strong; the forces between molecules are weak.

misconceptions.wrong: You break covalent bonds when boiling.
misconceptions.right: You overcome weak intermolecular forces, not bonds.
They have no free electrons or ions, so they don't conduct.
